reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight of HiveMind is that concurrent LLM agents competing for rate-limited APIs mirror OS process contention for CPU/memory/I/O. The proxy implements five primitives: admission control gates entry via a dynamic counter; rate-limit tracking parses headers and enforces proactive pauses; AIMD adjusts concurrency based on latency and error signals; circuit breaker halts traffic on failure bursts; and priority queuing ensures critical tasks proceed. These map directly to OS scheduling concepts—process admission, resource accounting, feedback control, fault isolation, and task prioritization. Failure modes like thrashing and starvation are mitigated by preventing overload and enabling graceful degradation. The proxy operates transparently without agent code changes, leveraging HTTP semantics and async I/O for efficiency.
